title: Project Accounting Standards: Deposits, Lender Funding, Payment Application and Close-Out for Replacement System Installations
content:
# Deposits, balance and close-out — Replacement System Installations

## A. Deposit at signing

A.1 A project not financed for its full contract price takes a deposit at signing; a project whose approved financing covers the full contract price takes no deposit.

A.2 The clause that fixed the deposit as the package's deposit percentage of the contract price or the package's smallest deposit, whichever is higher, rounded to the cent half up, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the contract deposit.

## B. Remaining balance

B.1 The clause that made the remaining balance due the package's balance-due days after the installation date, where 0 means on the installation day, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the balance.

B.2 A financed project's balance is paid by the lender's disbursement, which posts on the project as a financing disbursement payment naming the financing account. The homeowner pays any part of the balance the financing does not cover.

## C. Application of payments

Payments are applied to the oldest charge on the project first.

## D. Close-out

D.1 A project closes only once it is inspected and its project balance is 0.00.

D.2 A project balance still owing after inspection keeps the project in inspected status until it is paid.

## Close-out table

| Project status | Project balance | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Inspected | 0.00 | The project closes |
| Inspected | Above 0.00 | Stays inspected until paid |
| Installed (not yet inspected) | Any | Does not close |

## Illustration (hypothetical project)

A hypothetical project carries a contract-price charge posted at signing and a permit-fee charge posted later. A payment toward that project is applied first to the contract-price charge, the older of the two. If the project then passes inspection with $120.00 still owing, it stays in inspected status until the $120.00 is paid.
